context: The scene is a mess‑hall gossip between three noble attendants/bodyguards (for Lord Amber, Lady Durinbold and Lord Shattershield) leaning in about the Steel Watch’s giant clockwork sentries. Two of them loudly praise the Watchers as the only thing keeping the city and noble households safe, while the Amber guard admits unease and distrust. The Watchers are tied to the Steel Watch Foundry and its Neurocitor control links, and recent tampering, sabotage and disputes over the Foundry — plus rumors tying control to Gortash — have made them a heated, politicized topic. The player has already been involved in Foundry/Neurocitor events, so any interjection will be interpreted against that wider crisis and can affect how both people and machines react.
